# `passportsim scenario`

Run or validate a scenario file, and write the JUnit report.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Caps group | `core` |
| MCP tool | `passport_scenario` |
| HTTP route | `POST /v1/instances/{id}/commands/scenario` |
| Scenario step | none |
| CLI aliases | none |
| Annotations | `advances_time` |

## Hosts

The matrix below is the full one; this page is byte-identical on every host.

| macOS | Windows | Browser |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes |

## Synopsis

```text
passportsim scenario [file] [--inline <INLINE>] [--instance <INSTANCE>] [--jobs <JOBS>] [--junit <JUNIT>] [--op <OP>] [--stop-on-failure] [--strict] [--wall-budget-ms <WALL_BUDGET_MS>] [--json <@file|->]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Form | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | `<file>` | `string` | no | Scenario file or glob; quote it. |
| `inline` | `--inline <INLINE>` | `string` | no | Scenario YAML text. |
| `instance` | `--instance <INSTANCE>` | `string` | no | Instance id. |
| `jobs` | `--jobs <JOBS>` | `integer` | no | Instances the host may run in parallel (1). |
| `junit` | `--junit <JUNIT>` | `string` | no | JUnit path, relative and forward-slashed. |
| `op` | `--op <OP>` | `"run"` \| `"validate"` | no | What to do (run). |
| `stop_on_failure` | `--stop-on-failure` | `boolean` | no | Stop at the first failing step (true). |
| `strict` | `--strict` | `boolean` | no | Strict exit codes: a caveat exits 7 rather than 10 (false). |
| `vars` | carried by `--json` | `object` | no | `${var}` values. |
| `wall_budget_ms` | `--wall-budget-ms <WALL_BUDGET_MS>` | `integer` | no | Host budget in ms (600000). |

A nested object or array is passed as one JSON document with `--json @<file>` or `--json -`; it has no flag of its own.

Input schema: [`docs/schema/commands/scenario.input.json`](../schema/commands/scenario.input.json).

## Output

Output schema: [`docs/schema/commands/scenario.output.json`](../schema/commands/scenario.output.json).
TypeScript types: `web/src/gen/commands/scenario.d.ts` (`ScenarioArgs`, `ScenarioResult`).

| Code | Number |
|---|---|
| `E_USAGE` | 1 |
| `E_STATE` | 2 |
| `E_TIMEOUT` | 4 |
| `E_WALL_BUDGET` | 5 |
| `E_LEASE` | 6 |
| `E_INTERNAL` | 17 |

Every code is listed in [`docs/errors.md`](../errors.md).

## Examples

### Run one scenario file

```sh
passportsim scenario --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "file": "tests/scenarios/official-menu-smoke.yaml"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "file": "tests/scenarios/official-menu-smoke.yaml"
}
'@ | passportsim scenario --json -
```

### Run a whole suite and write one JUnit file

```sh
passportsim scenario --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "file": "tests/scenarios/*.yaml",
  "jobs": 8,
  "junit": "junit.xml"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "file": "tests/scenarios/*.yaml",
  "jobs": 8,
  "junit": "junit.xml"
}
'@ | passportsim scenario --json -
```

### Check that a scenario reads without running it

```sh
passportsim scenario --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "file": "tests/scenarios/*.yaml",
  "op": "validate"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "file": "tests/scenarios/*.yaml",
  "op": "validate"
}
'@ | passportsim scenario --json -
```

### Run a scenario written inline

```sh
passportsim scenario --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "inline": "schema: passportsim/scenario@1\nname: smoke\nsteps:\n  - delay: 1ms\n"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "inline": "schema: passportsim/scenario@1\nname: smoke\nsteps:\n  - delay: 1ms\n"
}
'@ | passportsim scenario --json -
```
